name: Survey: Likert summary and group comparison
description: Summarise agreement items answered on a 1 to 5 scale, compare them between groups of respondents and chart the answers.

slots.question: Which columns are the questions answered on a 1 to 5 scale?
Which column says which group a respondent is in?

steps.name: Summarise items
steps.purpose: How many answered each question and how many agree.

agree_from.label: Agree from
agree_from.meaning: The lowest answer counted as agreement.
agree_from.consequence: Lower counts more answers as agreement.

steps.name: Compare groups
steps.purpose: Which questions were answered differently by the groups.

fdr.label: False discovery rate
fdr.meaning: Share of flagged questions that may differ by chance.

steps.name: Chart the answers
steps.purpose: Show the spread of answers for every question.
